H2332.name: Eve
H2332.desc: Woman living at the time before the Flood
H2332.brief: First woman; wife of Adam; tempted by the serpent.
H2332.short: Eve was the first woman, created as Adam's wife, who was tempted by the serpent and ate the forbidden fruit.

H2301.name: Hadad
H2301.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2301.brief: A son of Ishmael, Abraham's son.
H2301.short: Hadad was one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, Abraham's son.

H2311.name: Hadlai
H2311.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2311.brief: Father of Amasa, who opposed taking captives from Judah.
H2311.short: Hadlai was the father of Amasa, who opposed taking captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz.

H2341I.name: Havilah
H2341I.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2341I.brief: A son of Joktan, descendant of Shem.
H2341I.short: Havilah was a son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H2341H.name: Havilah
H2341H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2341H.brief: A son of Cush, descendant of Ham.
H2341H.short: Havilah was a son of Cush, a descendant of Ham, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H2371.name: Hazael
H2371.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2371.brief: King of Aram (Syria), anointed by Elijah.
H2371.short: Hazael, king of Aram, was anointed by Elijah and fought against Israel and Judah.

H2382.name: Hazaiah
H2382.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2382.brief: Ancestor of Maaseiah, who lived in Jerusalem.
H2382.short: Hazaiah was an ancestor of Maaseiah, a leader who lived in Jerusalem.

H2381.name: Haziel
H2381.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2381.brief: A Levite of the family of Shimei.
H2381.short: Haziel was a Levite of the family of Shimei during the time of David.

H2375.name: Hazo
H2375.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2375.brief: A son of Nahor, Abraham's brother.
H2375.short: Hazo was a son of Nahor, the brother of Abraham.

H2396G.name: Hezekiah
H2396G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2396G.short: Hezekiah was a king of Judah who instituted religious reforms and trusted in God during the Assyrian invasion.

H2396I.name: Hezekiah
H2396I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2396I.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem.
H2396I.short: Hezekiah was an ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem.

H2396J.name: Hezekiah
H2396J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2396J.brief: A clan leader who returned from Babylonian exile.
H2396J.short: Hezekiah was a clan leader among the exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H2396K.name: Hezekiah
H2396K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2396K.short: Hezekiah was an ancestor of the prophet Zephaniah.

H2383.name: Hezion
H2383.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2383.brief: Grandfather of Ben-Hadad, king of Aram.
H2383.short: Hezion was the grandfather of Ben-Hadad I, the king of Aram during the reign of Asa, king of Judah.

H2387G.name: Hezir
H2387G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2387G.brief: A priest in the time of David.
H2387G.short: Hezir was a priest who was assigned the 17th division of priestly service in the time of King David.

H2387H.name: Hezir
H2387H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2387H.brief: A priest who sealed the covenant.
H2387H.short: Hezir was one of the priests who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

H2340.name: Hivites
H2340.short: The Hivites were one of the Canaanite tribes inhabiting the land promised to the Israelites.

H2395.name: Hizki
H2395.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2395.short: Hizki was a descendant of Elpaal from the tribe of Benjamin.

H2396H.name: Hizkiah
H2396H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2396H.brief: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.
H2396H.short: Hizkiah was one of the descendants of King David through the line of Jeconiah.

H2321.name: Hodesh
H2321.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2321.short: Hodesh was one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, and the mother of several of his children.

H2369H.name: Hotham
H2369H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2369H.brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Aroer.
H2369H.short: Hotham the Aroerite was listed among David's mighty warriors known for their military exploits.

H2369G.name: Hotham
H2369G.short: Hotham, also known as Helem, was a descendant of Asher mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H2343.name: Hul
H2343.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2343.brief: A son of Aram, grandson of Shem.
H2343.short: Hul was one of the sons of Aram and a grandson of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H2354G.name: Hur
H2354G.desc: Aaron's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2354G.brief: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.
H2354G.short: Hur was a prominent figure during the Israelites' journey in the wilderness, serving as a support to Moses and the grandfather of Bezalel, the chief artisan of the tabernacle.

H2354I.name: Hur
H2354I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2354I.brief: A ruler who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.
H2354I.short: Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, was involved in repairing a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

H2354H.name: Hur
H2354H.desc: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2354H.brief: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites.
H2354H.short: Hur was one of the five Midianite kings slain by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

H2359.name: Huri
H2359.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2359.short: Huri was a descendant of Gad, mentioned in the genealogy of the Gadites.

H2364.name: Hushah
H2364.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2364.brief: A son or town founded by Ezer.
H2364.short: Hushah was either a descendant of Judah or a town founded by Ezer in the tribe of.

H2365.name: Hushai
H2365.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H2365.brief: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.
H2365.short: Hushai the Arkite was a loyal friend and advisor to King David, who helped him during Absalom's rebellion by countering the advice of Ahithophel.

H2367.name: Husham
H2367.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2367.short: Husham was a king of Edom who reigned before the Israelites had kings, according to the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H2366G.name: Hushim
H2366G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2366G.brief: A son of Aher, from the tribe of Dan.
H2366G.short: Hushim, a son of Aher, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Dan in 1 Chronicles.

H2366A.name: Hushim
H2366A.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2366A.brief: A son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite.
H2366A.short: Hushim was one of the sons of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, born to him in the country of Moab.

H2366B.name: Hushim
H2366B.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2366B.brief: Son of Dan, ancestor of the Shuhamites.
H2366B.short: Hushim, also known as Shuham, was the son of Dan and the ancestor of the Shuhamite clan within the tribe of Dan.

H2322.name: Hadashah
H2322.brief: A town in the Shephelah region of Judah.
H2322.short: Hadashah was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah, located in the Shephelah region (<ref="Joshua 15:37">Joshua 15:37</ref>).

H2307.name: Hadid
H2307.brief: A town in Benjamin, resettled after the Babylonian exile.
H2307.short: Hadid was a town in Benjamin, whose inhabitants returned from the Babylonian exile and resettled in the town (<ref="Ezra 2:33; Nehemiah 7:37; 11:34">Ezra 2:33; Nehemiah 7:37; 11:34</ref>).

H2317.name: Hadrach
H2317.brief: A region mentioned in a prophetic oracle of judgment.
H2317.short: Hadrach was a region mentioned in a prophetic oracle of judgment, possibly located in Syria (<ref="Zechariah 9:1">Zechariah 9:1</ref>).

H2362.name: Hauran
H2362.brief: Region east of the Sea of Galilee
H2362.short: Hauran was a fertile region located east of the Sea of Galilee, mentioned as part of Israel's future boundaries (<ref="Ezk.47.16">Ezk.47.16,18</ref>).

H2341G.name: Havilah
H2341G.brief: Land near Eden with gold, bdellium, and onyx
H2341G.short: Havilah was a land mentioned in the description of Eden, known for its pure gold, aromatic resin (bdellium), and onyx stone (<ref="Gen.2.11-12">Gen.2.11-12</ref>).

H2341J.name: Havilah
H2341J.brief: Region inhabited by Ishmaelites, raided by Saul
H2341J.short: Havilah was a region inhabited by the descendants of Ishmael (<ref="Gen.25.18">Gen.25.18</ref>), which was later raided by King Saul during his campaign against the Amalekites (<ref="1Sa.15.7">1Sa.15.7</ref>).

H2334.name: Havvoth-jair
H2334.brief: Villages in Gilead captured by Jair
H2334.short: Havvoth-jair were villages in Gilead captured by Jair, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh, during the Israelite conquest of the region (<ref="Num.32.41; Deut 3:14; Judg 10:4; 1Ch.2.23">Num.32.41; Deut 3:14; Judg 10:4; 1Ch.2.23</ref>).

H2327.name: Hobah
H2327.brief: Place north of Damascus pursued by Abraham
H2327.short: Hobah was a place north of Damascus where Abraham pursued the defeated army of Chedorlaomer after rescuing Lot (<ref="Gen.14.15">Gen.14.15</ref>).

H2319G.name: New Gate
H2319G.brief: A gate in Jerusalem during Jeremiah's time
H2319G.short: The New Gate was a gate in Jerusalem during the time of the prophet Jeremiah.

H2313.name: Tigris
H2313.brief: River flowing from Eden, mentioned in Daniel's vision
H2313.short: Tigris, one of the rivers flowing from the Garden of Eden (<ref="Gen. 2:14">Gen. 2:14</ref>), and the location of Daniel's vision (<ref="Dan. 10:4">Dan. 10:4</ref>).
